Apply the existing recursive precision and f/e notation separately to real/imag components, reconstruct numerically preserving supported complex subclasses and existing signed-zero/nonfinite policies. comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
